description: This file defines configuration options and factory functions for creating Slack WebClient instances with specific retry policies, used for interacting with Slack APIs.

methods.name: export function resolveSlackWebClientOptions(options: WebClientOptions = {}): WebClientOptions { resolveSlackWebClientOptions
methods.description: Merges provided WebClientOptions with default retry configuration for Slack WebClient.

methods.name: export function resolveSlackWriteClientOptions(options: WebClientOptions = {}): WebClientOptions/ resolveSlackWriteClientOptions
methods.description: Merges provided WebClientOptions with write-specific retry configuration for Slack WebClient.

methods.name: export function createSlackWebClient(token: string, options: WebClientOptions = {}) { createSlackWebClient
methods.description: Creates an instance of WebClient with default retry options for normal Slack API interactions.

methods.name: export function createSlackWriteClient(token: string, options: WebClientOptions = {}) { createSlackWriteClient
methods.description: Creates an instance of WebClient with write retry options for Slack API write operations.
